# Kit Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads and writes your Kit account (formerly ConvertKit): list subscribers, broadcasts, sequences, and tags; create broadcast drafts. Sending to the list emails real people — the skill confirms the subject, audience, and content first, and adding subscribers to sequences that email them is confirmation-gated. Reading needs no confirmation. Honest note: broadcast-create defaults to a draft; only `--send` actually sends. Kit has a free plan. Draft: written from Kit's public v4 API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
